hero.title: Watermain contractor.

image.alt: NSC crew installing gate valves and blue water mains in a trench

blocks.title: Water work for public owners.
blocks.body:
Our crews excavate, install and test water services and connect them to municipal watermains. On Kingston Road for the University Endowment Lands we renewed water services, installed a fire hydrant and made two watermain tie-ins alongside the sewer separation.

At schools in Surrey, Richmond, Delta, New Westminster and Burnaby we have upgraded onsite and offsite fire and domestic water services as part of additions, modular classrooms and site upgrades.

items.title: Watermain tie-ins
items.text: Connections to existing municipal watermains, as on Kingston Road.

items.title: Fire and domestic water services
items.text: New and upgraded onsite and offsite fire and domestic water services for schools and buildings.

items.title: Fire hydrants
items.text: Hydrant installation as part of street and service work.

items.title: Water service renewals
items.text: Replacing water services to properties along a street.

items.title: Trenching and backfill
items.text: Excavation, bedding, backfill and compaction for water lines.

items.title: Restoration
items.text: Concrete and road surface restoration after the work.

items.q: Do you install watermains and water services?
items.a: Yes. We install fire and domestic water services, make watermain tie-ins, renew water services and install hydrants.

items.q: Who have you done water work for?
items.a: The University Endowment Lands and School Districts 36, 37, 38, 40 and 41, among others. See the projects above.

items.q: How do I get a price?
items.a: Send drawings or a tender package to info@nscltd.ca or call 604-644-5884.

blocks.title: Need water services installed?
blocks.text: Send drawings, a tender package or a prequalification request. Our estimating team will respond within one business day.
